qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: The lights went out right in the middle of our family dinner.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: We were having our family dinner when the lights went out.
qs.e: Cấu trúc thì quá khứ tiếp diễn kết hợp quá khứ đơn với "when" để chỉ hành động đang xảy ra thì hành động khác xen vào.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: I haven't gone jogging with my old school friend since we ran into each other in the park.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: The last time I went jogging with my old school friend was when we ran into each other in the park.
qs.e: Cấu trúc chuyển đổi từ hiện tại hoàn thành sang "The last time... was when...".

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: During her speech to the students, the teacher fainted.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: While the teacher was giving her speech to the students, she fainted.
qs.e: Dùng "While" với thì quá khứ tiếp diễn để diễn tả hành động kéo dài bị hành động ngắn xen vào.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: The earthquake occurred during her shower.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: She was having a shower when the earthquake occurred.
qs.e: Diễn tả hành động đang tắm (quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì động đất xảy ra (quá khứ đơn).

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: Immediately after the alarm went off this morning, she woke up.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: She woke up as soon as the alarm went off this morning.
qs.e: Dùng liên từ "as soon as" để diễn tả hai hành động nối tiếp nhau ngay lập tức trong quá khứ.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: The sudden arrival of the guests interrupted his book reading.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: He was reading a book when the guests suddenly arrived.
qs.e: Hành động đang đọc sách bị gián đoạn bởi sự xuất hiện bất ngờ của khách.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: My mother started cooking dinner at the same time my father started reading a book.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: While my mother was cooking dinner, my father was reading a book.
qs.e: Dùng "While" kết hợp hai mệnh đề quá khứ tiếp diễn để chỉ hai hành động song song diễn ra cùng lúc.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: In the middle of their football match, it started to rain heavily.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: They were playing football when it started to rain heavily.
qs.e: Hành động đang chơi bóng đá bị gián đoạn bởi trời mưa lớn.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: She felt a sharp pain while she was listening to music.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: When she was listening to music, she felt a sharp pain.
qs.e: Đảo mệnh đề "while" sang dùng "when" với cấu trúc tương đương.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: The students began taking notes during the teacher's explanation of the lesson.
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: While the teacher was explaining the lesson, the students began taking notes.
qs.e: Dùng "While" để chỉ hành động giảng bài đang diễn ra thì học sinh bắt đầu ghi chép.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: Queen Hieu Linh remained loyal and stood by King Tran Thanh Tong in both good times and bad times during the wartime. (THROUGH)
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Queen Hieu Linh remained loyal and stood by King Tran Thanh Tong through thick and thin during the wartime.
qs.e: Sử dụng thành ngữ "through thick and thin" (qua mọi thăng trầm, gian khó).

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: Steve Jobs experienced a period of alternating massive successes and painful setbacks throughout his thin career. (RIDE)
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Steve Jobs' career was a roller coaster ride of alternating massive successes and painful setbacks.
qs.e: Sử dụng cụm danh từ "a roller coaster ride" để chỉ sự thăng trầm liên tục trong sự nghiệp.

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: After dropping out of college, he was at a point where he had to make a crucial decision that would affect his future. (CROSSROADS)
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: After dropping out of college, he was at a crossroads that would affect his future. || After dropping out of college, he landed himself at a crossroads that would affect his future.
qs.e: Sử dụng cụm từ "at a crossroads" (đứng trước ngã ba đường, thời điểm quyết định quan trọng).

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: Winning the national math contest was a major event that completely changed his life and led him to become a famous teacher. (POINT)
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Winning the national math contest was a turning point that completely changed his life and led him to become a famous teacher.
qs.e: Sử dụng từ "turning point" (điểm ngoặt, bước ngoặt cuộc đời).

qs.s: Rewrite the following sentences: After surviving a long battle with pancreatic cancer, the leader decided to completely change his healthy lifestyle to focus on charity. (LEAF)
qs.ins: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: After surviving a long battle with pancreatic cancer, the leader decided to turn over a new leaf and focus on charity.
qs.e: Sử dụng thành ngữ "turn over a new leaf" (lật sang trang mới, cải thiện bản thân).

qs.s: The doctor recommended immediate ______ (SURGEON) to remove the tumor before it could spread.
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: surgery
qs.e: Chuyển danh từ chỉ người (surgeon) sang danh từ chỉ ngành/phẫu thuật (surgery).

qs.s: The band's latest album is very poor although ______ (DEVOTE) fans might enjoy it.
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: devoted
qs.e: Chuyển danh từ/động từ thành tính từ "devoted" (tận tụy, trung thành).

qs.s: The corporate team building retreat was designed to enhance communication and ______ among employees. (COLLABORATE)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: collaboration
qs.e: Chuyển động từ "collaborate" thành danh từ "collaboration" (sự hợp tác).

qs.s: It takes a lot of ______ and hard work to complete a marathon, especially for beginners. (DETERMINE)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: determination
qs.e: Chuyển động từ "determine" thành danh từ "determination" (sự quyết tâm).

qs.s: He left school at 16, not because he was ______ but because he wanted to get on with his working life. (AMBITION)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: unambitious
qs.e: Thêm tiền tố "un-" để tạo tính từ trái nghĩa "unambitious" (thiếu hoài bão).

qs.s: The university is proud to offer ______ research facilities that attract top students from all over the world. (CUT)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: cutting-edge
qs.e: Sử dụng tính từ ghép "cutting-edge" (hiện đại bậc nhất, tiên tiến).

qs.s: Pixar's first full-length ______ film, Toy Story, completely revolutionized the movie industry in 1995. (ANIMATE)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: animated
qs.e: Chuyển động từ "animate" thành tính từ "animated" (hoạt hình).

qs.s: The tech company owes its success to the constant ______ of its products based on user feedback. (INNOVATE)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: innovation
qs.e: Chuyển động từ "innovate" thành danh từ "innovation" (sự đổi mới).

qs.s: The CEO's clear ______ guided the company through one of the worst financial crises in history. (VISIONARY)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: vision
qs.e: Chuyển từ gốc thành danh từ "vision" (tầm nhìn).

qs.s: Although they are twins, they grew up with different families because they were given up for ______ at birth. (ADOPT)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: adoption
qs.e: Chuyển động từ "adopt" thành danh từ "adoption" (sự nhận nuôi).

qs.s: The scenery along the coastal road was so ______ that many tourists pulled over just to take photographs. (POEM)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: poetic
qs.e: Chuyển danh từ "poem" thành tính từ "poetic" (thơ mộng, trữ tình).

qs.s: The keynote speaker delivered an ______ speech that motivated the students to pursue their dreams. (INSPIRE)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: inspiring
qs.e: Chuyển danh từ/động từ thành tính từ "inspiring" (truyền cảm hứng).

qs.s: There has been strong ______ to the proposed tax increases. (RESIST)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: resistance
qs.e: Chuyển động từ "resist" thành danh từ "resistance" (sự kháng cự, phản đối).

qs.s: Television has an important role to play in ______ new scientific ideas. (POPULAR)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: popularizing || popularising
qs.e: Chuyển tính từ "popular" thành động từ "popularize" rồi thêm đuôi "-ing" sau giới từ "in".

qs.s: Repairs have already begun and we expect the factory to be fully ______ again within six months. (OPERATE)
qs.ins: Give the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: operational
qs.e: Chuyển động từ "operate" thành tính từ "operational" (hoạt động được).

qs.s: The movie "Mua do" became a ______, admired for its realistic portrayal of the resistance.
qs.e: "Blockbuster" chỉ phim bom tấn thu hút đông đảo khán giả[cite: 17].

qs.s: The coach gave an ______ talk that energized the players before the final match.
qs.e: Tính từ "inspiring" đứng trước danh từ để bổ nghĩa, chỉ bài phát biểu truyền cảm hứng[cite: 17].

qs.s: The field hospital became fully ______ after weeks of hard work.
qs.e: Cần tính từ "operational" sau trạng từ "fully" để chỉ trạng thái đã đi vào hoạt động[cite: 17].

qs.s: ______ of college was a difficult decision, but it allowed her to become one of the most respected nurses in the resistance.
qs.e: Cụm động từ "dropping out of college" có nghĩa là bỏ học đại học[cite: 17].

qs.s: Uncle Ho was admired ______ his dedication to the Vietnamese independence movement and his profound love for the people.
qs.e: Cấu trúc "admire sb for sth": ngưỡng mộ ai vì điều gì[cite: 17].

qs.s: From a young age, she was determined to ______ her youth and whole life to the preservation of endangered species.
qs.e: Cấu trúc "dedicate sth to sth": cống hiến cái gì cho việc gì[cite: 17].

qs.s: Vo Nguyen Giap was widely recognized as a ______ genius for his pivotal role in leading Vietnamese forces during the First Indochina War and the Vietnam War.
qs.e: "Military genius" chỉ thiên tài quân sự xuất chúng[cite: 17].

qs.s: As a ______ thinker, she proposed strategies that saved thousands of lives.
qs.e: "Visionary thinker" là nhà tư tưởng có tầm nhìn chiến lược xa rộng[cite: 17].

qs.s: Through personal ______ of her experiences during the war, she highlighted the role of women in resistance movements.
qs.e: "Personal accounts" chỉ những lời kể, nhân chứng hoặc bản tường thuật cá nhân[cite: 17].

qs.s: Her biological parents were unable to raise her, so she was ______ by a family who provided her with a loving home.
qs.e: Từ "adopted" có nghĩa là được nhận làm con nuôi[cite: 17].

qs.s: Jobs met Steve Wozniak and they quickly ______ over their love of electronics, a shared passion that would eventually lead to the founding of Apple.
qs.e: Cụm "bond over sth" chỉ việc gắn kết mối quan hệ qua một sở thích chung[cite: 17].

qs.s: Most people ______ him when he dropped out, but he went back and earned his degree two years later.
qs.e: Cụm động từ "give up on" mang nghĩa mất niềm tin vào ai đó.

qs.s: Having a difficult childhood did not hold her back; instead, it inspired her to devote her life to social work, helping others ______ similar challenges.
qs.e: Từ "overcome" có nghĩa là vượt qua những thử thách tương tự[cite: 17].

qs.s: She always ______ to improving the community and her efforts are still celebrated today.
qs.e: Cấu trúc "devote oneself to sth": tận tụy, cống hiến hết mình cho việc gì[cite: 17].

qs.s: A scientist once said that effort accounts for 99% of success and ______ accounts for only 1%.
qs.e: Câu danh ngôn so sánh giữa nỗ lực, thiên tài/kiến thức và kỹ năng[cite: 17].

qs.s: He taught others how to ______ fear and stay strong during the battle.
qs.e: Động từ "resist" có nghĩa là chống lại, kháng cự lại sự sợ hãi[cite: 17].

qs.s: ______ happened in Vietnam from 1955 to 1975.
qs.e: Tên sự kiện lịch sử: Cuộc kháng chiến chống Mỹ cứu nước[cite: 17].

qs.s: Jobs was diagnosed ______ a rare form of pancreatic cancer.
qs.e: Cấu trúc bị động "diagnosed with a disease": được chẩn đoán mắc bệnh gì[cite: 17].

qs.s: Despite losing her ______ in the war, she was raised by a kind veteran who shared their heroic stories.
qs.e: Cụm "biological parents" chỉ cha mẹ ruột thịt[cite: 17].

qs.s: Malala Yousafzai has devoted her efforts ______ for girls' education, becoming a global symbol of courage and resistance against oppression.
qs.e: Cấu trúc "devote efforts to doing sth": cống hiến nỗ lực vào việc làm gì[cite: 17].

qs.s: During the war, doctors and nurses worked tirelessly in the ______, providing care with limited resources.
qs.e: "Field hospital" có nghĩa là bệnh viện dã chiến phục vụ thời chiến[cite: 17].

qs.s: There was a ______ two-minute silence as we remembered the soldiers who had died in the war.
qs.e: Tính từ "respectful" (đầy sự kính trọng) dùng bổ nghĩa cho khoảng lặng mặc niệm[cite: 17].

qs.s: Mark Zuckerberg's enormous success has taken a lot of hard work and ______.
qs.e: Danh từ "dedication" thể hiện sự cống hiến, tận tụy bền bỉ[cite: 17].

qs.s: A ______ once said "It is a sweet and honorable thing to die for your country."
qs.e: Tính từ danh hóa hoặc danh từ "patriot" (nhà ái quốc) phù hợp điền vào chủ ngữ câu nói[cite: 17].

qs.s: Jane never hesitates to do anything she wants. She's a ______ woman.
qs.e: Tính từ "determined" chỉ người kiên quyết, quyết đoán trong hành động[cite: 17].

qs.s: He has gone to the UK for further education since he ______ upper secondary school.
qs.e: Mệnh đề chỉ thời gian với "since" ở thì quá khứ đơn, mệnh đề chính ở hiện tại hoàn thành[cite: 17].

qs.s: When Tien ______ some photos of the wildlife reserve, it started to rain heavily.
qs.e: Hành động chụp ảnh đang diễn ra (quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì trời bất ngờ đổ mưa (quá khứ đơn)[cite: 17].

qs.s: He was talking to his mother about his first day at school when his phone ______.
qs.e: Hành động đang nói chuyện bị ngắt quãng bởi tiếng chuông điện thoại reo (quá khứ đơn)[cite: 17].

qs.s: His academic results have improved ______.
o: after he had taken this course
when he was taking this course
qs.e: Sử dụng mệnh đề trạng ngữ chỉ thời gian hoàn thành trước quá khứ/hiện tại[cite: 17].

qs.s: While Phong ______ a presentation, his laptop suddenly crashed.
qs.e: Hành động thuyết trình đang diễn ra (quá khứ tiếp diễn) thì máy tính xách tay bị hỏng[cite: 17].

qs.s: I ______ an online class in Advanced Maths when the Wi-Fi got disconnected.
qs.e: Hành động học trực tuyến đang diễn ra thì mạng ngắt kết nối đột ngột[cite: 17].

qs.s: Please go to my office ______.
qs.e: Giới từ "upon" kết hợp cụm danh từ "your arrival" chỉ thời điểm đến nơi[cite: 17].

qs.s: The students ______ the floor when the headmistress came in.
qs.e: Hành động lau sàn đang diễn ra thì hiệu trưởng bước vào lớp[cite: 17].

qs.s: As soon as they arrived on the beach, it started to rain.
o: Had it started to rain, they would have arrived on the beach.
Hardly had they arrived on the beach when it started to rain.
No sooner did they arrive on the beach than it started to rain.
Scarcely had they arrived on the beach than it started to rain.
qs.e: Cấu trúc đảo ngữ diễn tả hai hành động xảy ra nối tiếp[cite: 17].

qs.s: He started phoning his friends as soon as he finished his work.
o: Only when he phoned his friends did he finish his work.
Hardly had he started phoning his friends when he finished his work.
No sooner had he finished his work than he started phoning his friends.
Before he finished his work, he had started phoning his friends.
qs.e: Đảo ngữ diễn tả hành động này vừa xong thì hành động kia lập tức tiếp nối[cite: 17].

qs.s: While the kids ______ in the backyard, I ______ dinner.
qs.e: Hai hành động diễn ra song song cùng lúc trong quá khứ nên dùng thì quá khứ tiếp diễn cho cả hai vế[cite: 17].

qs.s: She ______ when the alarm ______ off this morning.
qs.e: Hành động đang ngủ bị tiếng báo thức reo làm gián đoạn[cite: 17].

qs.s: While the teacher ______ the lesson, the students ______ notes.
qs.e: Hai hành động giáo viên giảng bài và học sinh ghi chép diễn ra song song[cite: 17].

qs.s: I ______ in the park when I ______ my old school friend.
qs.e: Hành động đang chạy bộ thì tình cờ gặp bạn cũ[cite: 17].

qs.s: She ______ a shower when the earthquake _______.
qs.e: Hành động đang tắm thì trận động đất xảy ra đột ngột[cite: 17].

qs.s: She ______ to music when she suddenly ______ a sharp pain.
qs.e: Hành động đang nghe nhạc thì đột ngột cảm thấy đau nhói[cite: 17].

qs.s: At exactly 9 p.m. last night, the military commanders ______ the top-secret strategy for the upcoming counter-attack in the resistance war.
qs.e: Hành động diễn ra tại thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ chia ở quá khứ tiếp diễn[cite: 17].

qs.s: While the surgeon ______ on the injured soldier, the artillery fire outside suddenly intensified, shaking the ground beneath them.
qs.e: Hành động phẫu thuật đang diễn ra thì tiếng pháo binh bên ngoài đột ngột gia tăng cường độ[cite: 17].

qs.s: Steve Jobs ______ Reed College just six months after enrollment because he found the required classes stifling his creative ambition.
qs.e: Cụm động từ "drop out of college": bỏ học giữa chừng đại học[cite: 17].

qs.s: Throughout the resistance war, the guerrilla fighters ______ in the deep jungle while the enemy forces searched the nearby villages.
qs.e: Hành động ẩn nấp kéo dài liên tục trong rừng sâu khi kẻ địch đang lùng sục[cite: 17].
